## What this issue is about
This issue is focused on enhancing the Workflow Manager in the Volto project, which is part of Plone. A visual representation of the current workflow has been provided to help illustrate the existing setup.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to improve the Workflow Manager's functionality. Specific tasks were not detailed in the discussions, so expect some ambiguity about exact requirements and implementation steps.

## Helpful background
The Workflow Manager helps users manage content states and transitions in the Plone CMS. Understanding workflows—how content moves from draft to published states—is essential. The comments indicate there's a connection to GSoC (Google Summer of Code), which might provide insights on further developments. 

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the current Workflow Manager and its functionalities.
2. Review the existing visuals provided in the issue description.
3. Reach out to the assignee, [iRohitSingh](https://github.com/iRohitSingh), for clarification, especially regarding GSoC details and the status of this enhancement.
4. Consider checking the repository for related documentation or any existing tests to understand the context better.
